title: Passing Depth
description: How far downfield each quarterback throws, and how often the deep ball connects. Air yards need full play descriptions, so 2022-2024 are blank.

columns.label: Air Yds/Att
columns.help: Average distance past the line of scrimmage the ball traveled on each attempt. Needs full play descriptions, so 2022-2024 are blank.

columns.label: Deep Att
columns.help: Passes the play-by-play labels deep (roughly 20+ air yards).

columns.label: Deep Pct
columns.help: Deep completions divided by deep attempts.

columns.label: Deep Share
columns.help: Share of the quarterback's attempts that were deep.
